brass_key.name: brass key
brass_key.description: A small brass key, cold in your hand.

vinyl_record.name: vinyl record
vinyl_record.description: A vinyl record in a paper sleeve. On the sleeve: 'For our anniversary: 02.11'.

raincoat.name: yellow raincoat
raincoat.examine: A yellow raincoat hangs on a hook. In the pocket you feel a small brass key.

diary.name: diary
diary.examine: Sky's small diary lies open on the desk. Sky writes about 'someone' without a name. One page says: 'The best day of my life.' A ticket stub is stuck beside it: 'Pier Festival, 14 Oct'. Further down: 'I will never forget 07.03.'
must_include: The best day of my life

corkboard.name: corkboard
corkboard.examine: Four photos of Sky through the seasons: spring, summer, autumn, winter. A birthday card is dated 23.06. One photo says 'happy birthday to you, 07.03'. In every photo, next to Sky, stands a blurry person.

drawer.name: drawer
drawer.examine: A drawer in the desk, with a small keyhole.
drawer.examine_when_open: The drawer is open. It is empty now.

when_opened.text: The key turns. Inside the drawer lies a vinyl record in a sleeve: 'For our anniversary: 02.11'.

record_player.name: record player
record_player.examine: A record player stands on the shelf. Nothing is on it.

when_used.text: The needle touches the record. Sky's voice fills the room.

door.name: door
door.examine: A heavy wooden door with a keypad for four digits.

calendar.name: calendar
calendar.examine: A wall calendar, still open at November. The 15th is circled in red: 'Exhibition!!'

desk.name: desk
desk.examine: A wooden desk. A diary lies on it, and it has a drawer.

bed.name: bed
bed.examine: A small bed with a faded blanket. It looks slept in a long time ago.

window.name: round window
window.examine: A round window. Soft blue light from the sea comes through it.

plain_messages.UNKNOWN_ACTION: Nothing like that is possible here.
plain_messages.UNKNOWN_TARGET: There is nothing like that in this room.
plain_messages.NOT_VISIBLE: You have not seen that yet.
plain_messages.NOT_IN_INVENTORY: You do not have that with you.
plain_messages.BAD_FORMAT: The keypad needs exactly four digits.
plain_messages.DOOR_OPENS: The keypad beeps. The door opens onto white light.
